Synthetic Corp Reports Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Results

NASDAQ: SYN

October 29, 2026

CEO Alice Example said "We are pleased to report strong Q3 results with revenue growth of 9% year-over-year."

CFO Bob Sample stated "Diluted earnings per share of $1.55 exceeded our guidance range."

The company reported diluted earnings per share of $1.55 for Q3 FY2026.

Revenue was $89,500,000,000 for Q3 FY2026.

Consensus estimates were EPS of $1.42 and revenue of $89,200,000,000.

The company expects Q4 FY2026 EPS of $1.60 to $1.70 and revenue of $91,000,000,000 to $93,000,000,000.

Guidance raised from previous EPS range of $1.50 to $1.60.

"We expect demand to remain strong in Q4," said Alice Example.

According to Bob Sample, "Margins are expanding due to operational improvements."
